connection_condition: question records are post records restricted to post type value 1
description: A question is a specific kind of post; its records form a subset of the post table distinguished by the post type discriminator.

connection_condition: answer records are post records restricted to post type value 2
description: An answer is a specific kind of post; answer records are a subset of the post table, each carrying a parent question.

connection_condition: the post owner identifier corresponds to the user account identifier
description: Each post is authored by at most one user account; a user owns many posts. The owner column is nullable for posts without a registered author.

connection_condition: the comment's post identifier corresponds to the post identifier
description: A comment is a component of the post it is attached to and cannot exist without that post.

connection_condition: the vote's post identifier corresponds to the post identifier
description: A vote record is a component of the post it targets and cannot exist without that post.

connection_condition: the vote caster identifier corresponds to the user account identifier, but is null for almost all vote types
description: A vote may be attributed to a user account; attribution is sparse because most vote records do not carry a user identifier.

connection_condition: the badge recipient identifier corresponds to the user account identifier
description: A badge award belongs to exactly one user account; an award cannot exist without its recipient.

connection_condition: the tag tokens embedded in the post tag list correspond to tag names in the tag vocabulary
description: Question posts carry a set of tags. The connection is many-to-many and is encoded as delimited text on the post rather than as a join table.

connection_condition: the comment author identifier corresponds to the user account identifier
description: A comment is written by one user account; a user may write many comments.

connection_condition: the tag excerpt post identifier corresponds to a post identifier
description: A tag's excerpt text is held in a designated post; not every tag has one.

connection_condition: the link source post identifier corresponds to a post identifier
description: A post link is a component anchored on the source post; the link cannot exist without that post.

connection_condition: the link related post identifier corresponds to a post identifier
description: A post link points at a related post and cannot exist without it.

connection_condition: each angle-bracket token inside the post tag list names a tag whose bare name appears in the tag vocabulary
description: Tag names in the tag vocabulary and tag tokens embedded in post tag lists express the same tag concepts, differing only in encoding.

connection_condition: the comment's stored display name corresponds to the display name of the comment's author account
description: The denormalized author display name on a comment expresses the same concept as the user account display name, verified with zero mismatches wherever it is populated.

connection_condition: the stored comment count equals the number of comment records whose post identifier matches the post
description: The post comment count is derivable by counting the comments attached to the post; the stored value agrees except for a small number of rows.

connection_condition: the stored answer count equals the number of answer posts whose parent identifier matches the question
description: The question answer count is derivable by counting the answers whose parent is that question; the stored value agrees exactly.

connection_condition: the stored tag count equals the number of question posts whose tag list contains that tag
description: The tag usage count is derivable by counting question posts that carry the tag; the stored value matched the observed counts for the tags checked.
